node.text: Had to go watch the full thing… and idk what everyone is saying. No one was close to dying? She got punched , fell down and choked out in two seconds. Nothing was over the top or to much. As far as I’m concerned she was just tired and laying there? Look for yourself
@katelynbaxley  Do I find it bs ‘athletes’ get payed more for putting on a show yes I do, but blue collar men also join up knowing the sacrifices they’ll have to make.
